rationale: PARSeq's frozen charset cannot emit a space. Three separate representations keep that limitation visible instead of hiding it inside a single normalization.

steps: convert every Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space
2_boundaryPreservingNormalized.purpose: Exposes PARSeq's inability to represent word boundaries.

3_whitespaceFreeComparable.purpose: The primary architecture-comparable representation, because PARSeq's charset cannot emit a space.

prohibited.note: Every entry is false: none of these transformations is applied anywhere.

metrics: truth present as a contiguous substring
useful-token recall (tokens of length >= 3, applied identically to both arms)

improvementThresholds.rule: An improvement requires a truth-bearing gain under the primary whitespace-free metrics: wrong to exact, materially lower CER, truth newly present, or a useful Brand fragment newly recovered. More characters, a higher score, or a merely non-empty output is never an improvement. A change between two equally wrong transcripts is NO_EFFECT unless one has objectively worse primary CER.

reportingRule: Both boundary-preserving and whitespace-free results are reported. Whitespace-free matching is never described as raw exact matching.
